name: qfd_slab_pg_cl-cl2-COMMIT
purpose: qwen-tp8/slab3 2026-10-12: ot_qwen_slab_port_group (s14o TP8 GT 3072 GID 47) v1-v3 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at 4_1_cts (-77 -> -55 -> -30.8 flat, 24,483 register sinks + 16 ROM clock pins on ONE root over 777x456 um, TT clock latency 610..963 ps). Structural fix: the group becomes a cluster of hardened sub-tiles, each with its own pin-flop row and local clock root: 4x ot_qwen_slab_pg_col (one ROM column: R2 copy, 4 x decode+ROM+C4 capture, M5 merge, registered m5 face) and 4x ot_qwen_slab_pg_lanes (4 FP32 multiplier lanes, IN_STAGE face registers); the cluster keeps request/tag/cacc/argmax/oreg on the clock spine. Same cycles, bit-exact benches unchanged (TP4 + TP8 PASS, 3 mutants FAIL). | this kit: the cluster (clock spine, child insertion targets) over the two hardened sub-tile views. | r3b 10-13: first submission of the cluster over the CLOSED children qfd_slab_pg_col_mgc-c5c (TT +141.97 / FF +1.69) and qfd_slab_pg_lanes-l1 (TT +197.43 / FF +6.22); this is the hardened unit of the six qfd_port_tiles_* slots (8 groups a slot, GID strap).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qwen_slab_port_group #(.MUL_LAT(7), .BW_FIFO(0), .OREG(1), .MUL_KCP(1), .IN_STAGE(1), .AM_SPLIT(1), .S5_CTL(1), .SCALE_PAIR(1), .GT(3072), .GID(47)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_SLAB_PG_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_slab_port_group.sv rtl/common/ot_meso_fifo.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src:tools python3 tools/qwen_slab_m3_takeover.py bench --variant s14o --tp 8 --mutant gt --out {RUN}/bench/tp8_gt

bench.cmd: PYTHONPATH=src:tools python3 tools/qwen_slab_m3_takeover.py bench --variant s14o --tp 8 --mutant gid --out {RUN}/bench/tp8_gid

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pg_cl/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pg_cl/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pg_cl --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_slab_port_group --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pg_col/views/ot_qwen_slab_pg_col --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pg_lanes/views/ot_qwen_slab_pg_lanes > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: flat ot_qwen_slab_port_group (v1-v3: 24,483 sinks on one root, hold stuck at 4_1_cts) -> cluster: 4 hardened ROM-column tiles + 4 hardened multiplier-lane tiles with their own roots; the parent keeps request/tag/cacc/argmax/oreg on the balanced spine
